name: neophp/framework
description: NeoPHP - an ultra modular PHP framework.

suggest.ext-dom: Required by the Serializer XML encoder, to convert HTML to Markdown (Markdown package: parse() and convert()) and to read XLIFF translation files (Translation package)
suggest.ext-apcu: Required by the "apcu" adapter of the Cache component (in-memory shared cache pools; set apc.enable_cli=1 to use it from the console)
suggest.ext-curl: Recommended by the HttpClient component (faster transport, parallel requests with requestMany()); the stream transport is used without it
suggest.ext-fileinfo: Required to detect the mime type of uploaded files (File and Image constraints) and of email attachments
suggest.ext-openssl: Required to send emails over SSL/TLS (smtps:// or STARTTLS) and to download the Tailwind CLI (tailwind:install)
suggest.ext-pcntl: Recommended by the Queue package (graceful stop of queue:work on SIGTERM / SIGINT) and the Scheduler package (schedule:work)
suggest.ext-pdo: Required to use the Database component
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Required to connect to MySQL / MariaDB databases
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Required to connect to PostgreSQL databases
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: Required to connect to SQLite databases
suggest.ext-redis: Required by the redis transport of the Queue package (redis://)
suggest.ext-zip: Required to archive log files as .zip
